## Activity

During June 2026, East City Eye Clinic completed 211 captures. Activity was maintained across the reporting period, and session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 211 captures, 7 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.3 per cent. The ungradable images should continue to be monitored through routine quality review so that any recurring issues can be identified and addressed. The rate provides a useful measure of the proportion of captures that could not proceed to grading.

## Grading

There were 64 referable results during June 2026. The median grading lag was 2 days. This indicates that grading activity continued within the reported period, with results reviewed following image capture. The referable outcome count and grading lag should be considered alongside the capture volume and image quality results when reviewing overall site performance. Further routine monitoring will support continued oversight of service delivery at East City Eye Clinic.
